unit_policy: all normalized CSV latency columns use ms; raw source may use us
key_conclusions: Pyramid H800+TVM FP16 backbone has strong MetaSchedule speedup; corrected base is about 56.321ms default to 6.320ms tuned, 8.912x.
Pyramid p75 corrected row reaches 12.689ms default to 0.484ms tuned, 26.237x, but lower AP70.
Pyramid Gap1 corrected W_g/P_g: trap25 default-Pareto drops after tuning; pad64 becomes tuned-Pareto at same AP70 0.590.
CoDriving H800+TVM backbone has weaker speedup around 1.135x-2.264x in current real rows, serving as negative/separable anchor.
Pyramid INT8 evidence is currently scope-limited mainly to stage0/format mechanisms; do not treat as full-backbone INT8 LUT without new generation.
CoDriving INT8 stage0 verifies no categorical trap; Cin48 and Cin64 both build and preserve rank ordering.
superseded_sources_to_avoid_as_claims: results/gap1_schedule_lut.json pad64 ratio=1.0 is superseded by results/gap1_grid_corrected.json pad64 ratio=7.706.
old C1/C7 claims that FP16 MetaSchedule had zero valid trials were corrected in C2_C3_pyramid.json; use revised verdicts.
